column1: # Project analyzers the audit runs when installed. tool, lens it feeds, path regex that makes it relevant, where it runs (root, or the package folder holding the matched file), command.
# Commands use only what is installed locally (npx --no-install); a missing tool is reported, never installed.
# {file} in a command is the matched file's name. ./gradlew may fetch Gradle itself on its first run.
